scenarios.scenario: Insight — Split the failures per target framework
scenarios.reasoning: The agent correctly identified the high-level structure (two TFMs, different root causes, net472 has far more errors due to missing .NET Core APIs) and used appropriate binlog querying techniques. However, it significantly undercounted errors on both frameworks (63 total vs ~167 expected), misattributed some error categories (placing string*StringComparison errors only on net472 when they also appear on net10.0), and gave an incomplete picture of net10.0 failures. The methodology was sound but the data extraction was incomplete, leading to inaccurate quantitative claims despite correct qualitative conclusions.

rubricScores.criterion: Quantified the per-framework split: net472 carries the large majority (~159, including all 64 FS0039), net10.0 only ~8
Concluded the net472 failures stem from missing .NET-only APIs (MetadataUpdater / AssemblyLoadContext)
Concluded the net10.0 failures are genuine type errors (e.g. 'byte array' is not an unmanaged type; string vs string*StringComparison tuple), independent of the framework
Stated these are TWO distinct problems, not one
Used the binlog's per-(project, target-framework) attribution as the evidence for the split
